### 目标
用 matplotlib 生成一张学术论文级柱状图，展示 CLS-CWM accuracy gap 随 complexity 增长而急剧放大。

### 数据（来自 registry，已验证）

| Complexity Level | CLS Acc (%) | CWM Acc (%) | Gap (pp) | Seeds | Error bar (std of gap) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Function 4B | 88.43 | 87.19 | 1.24 | 5 seeds | CLS std=0.78, CWM std=0.37 |
| Function 8B | 89.40 | 86.96 | 2.43 | 3 seeds (s42/s123/s456) | p=0.008 |
| Repo 4B-4B | 83.63 | 58.04 | 25.59 | 1 seed (s42) | N/A (single seed) |

Individual seed data for error bars:
- Function 4B CLS: s42=87.83, s123=89.52, s456=87.88, s789=89.00, s0=87.94 → mean=88.43
- Function 4B CWM: s42=87.51, s123=87.20, s456=86.98, s789=86.67, s0=87.57 → mean=87.19
- Function 8B CLS: s42=90.48, s123=89.40, s456=88.31 → mean=89.40
